blocks.text: I read this at 2am and had to put the book down,
"You can't heal in the same place that keeps breaking you. Some doors you close for your own peace."

caption:
Some doors you close for your own peace. 🖤
Is there a door you're still standing at? You don't have to answer out loud.
Save this for the night you want to go back.
